comparison.objective: Extract a connector terminal, versus loosen a nut with an adjustable wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed tab access and coordinated tensile withdrawal, versus jaw adjustment, snug wrench fit, and torque application.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed without housing/crimp damage; versus nut loosened without rounding and wrench removed and set down.
comparison.reason: Both require damage-aware tool use, but the operative contact and ability—latch release versus adjustable-wrench torque—are different.
